emoji_impact_shield_policy.purpose: Cover strong physical impacts to the face, head, or body organs (tools kicking back, objects hitting face, head-first slams)

safety_context_graphics_policy.purpose: Provide bottom-left safety/context disclaimer overlays spanning the full duration of intense/dangerous clips

sfx_placement_policy.density: ~1 SFX per 20-25s (selective, high-impact moments only; ~23 SFX in 8m15s)
timing_rules: Align SFX start with the exact physical climax/impact or comedic reaction frame (+0.7s to +4.3s inside the clip, never blindly at the cut point).
Avoid overlapping with A2 Voiceover (91% of SFX in kb100 occur in gaps where A2 VO is silent).

Allow resonant/long-tail SFX (oof, metallic-bonk-and-rattle, taco-bell-bong, car-brake, metal-gear-solid, duck-quack) to L-cut across the scene transition into the next clip rather than hard-cutting at clip end.
For profanity censoring, place censor-beep-1.mp3 (~0.21s) on A3 while keyframing A1 volume down over the swear word.

competitor_spinning_and_v3_prompt_formul.workflow_overview: Extract competitor's intro hook (00:00:00..00:00:15, e.g., FailSide Moment), translate for meaning check, rewrite/spin into ALL-CAPS high-energy ITV copy (elongated greeting + question hook + sit-back/eyes-open directive + launch shout), and wrap with ElevenLabs v3 Dual Audio Tags.

step_2_spin_and_amplify_rules: Write ENTIRE script in ALL CAPS to drive high vocal projection in eleven_v3.
Elongate opening greeting vowel: 'HELLOOOO, EVERYONE!' or 'HEYYYY, EVERYONE!'
Convert generic question into punchy hook ending with '?!': e.g., 'READY FOR A GOOD LAUGH?!'
Insert a high-retention viewer directive separated by an em-dash '—': e.g., 'YOU'RE IN THE RIGHT PLACE — SO SIT BACK, KEEP YOUR EYES OPEN, AND GET READY!'
Strip weak trailing words like 'then' from the CTA and end with triple exclamation marks: 'LET'S GET STARTED!!!'
competitor_spinning_and_v3_prompt_formul.step_3_elevenlabs_v3_dual_tag_template: [absurdist narration, accelerando, rushed, extreme fast] {GREETING_ALL_CAPS}! {HOOK_QUESTION_ALL_CAPS}?! {RETENTION_DIRECTIVE_ALL_CAPS}! [accelerando, rushed, energetic, shouting] {LAUNCH_CTA_ALL_CAPS}!!!
competitor_spinning_and_v3_prompt_formul.verified_prompt_example: [absurdist narration, accelerando, rushed, extreme fast] HELLOOOO, EVERYONE! READY FOR A GOOD LAUGH?! YOU'RE IN THE RIGHT PLACE — SO SIT BACK, KEEP YOUR EYES OPEN, AND GET READY! [accelerando, rushed, energetic, shouting] LET'S GET STARTED!!!
competitor_spinning_and_v3_prompt_formul.phonic_qc_rule: Always inspect generated audio with AI Audio (view_file): 'extreme fast' + em-dash ('PLACE —') can occasionally cause eleven_v3 to swallow final consonants (e.g., sounding like 'right plan' in take ef4f12b1 vs clean 'right place' in kb104 take 2026-10-16T09_23_51). Re-generate or replace '—' with ',' or '!' if a word is clipped.

dynamic_a2_slicing_rule.core_principle: NEVER hardcode a fixed number of A2 voiceover segments (not fixed to 3 or 5). The number of A2 segments dynamically adapts (from 2 to 6+ segments) based on the Intro Text's natural clause boundaries (punctuation: '!', '?!', '—', ',', '.') and the duration gap between the raw MP3 and the Teaser Montage.
dynamic_a2_slicing_rule.mandatory_split_1_greeting: Always split after the opening greeting ('HELLOOOO, EVERYONE!' / 'Hello everyone!', ~0.7s..1.8s) and leave a 0.55s..1.35s silence gap on A2 so Clip #1's Cold-Open crash climax + Impact Cross Zoom transition hit at full volume.
dynamic_a2_slicing_rule.adaptive_body_splits: Split the remaining VO only at natural text clause breaks where needed to (a) let loud mid-intro physical crashes/SFX punch through, and (b) pace the text evenly across the teaser clips so 'LET'S GET STARTED!!!' finishes ~0.4s..0.85s before the Warning card.

failside_intro_mastery_7_rules: 1. Hook Loop (Clip #1 Teaser = Clip #1 Main Body Climax): Use the 1.3s climax of the very first post-Warning clip as Clip #1 of the Intro (0.00..1.30s) so when the Warning card ends (18.65s), the viewer immediately gets the full context/payoff of that exact crash.
2. Pre-VO Cold Open Shock: Hit the viewer with 1-2 immediate physical crashes/groans in the first 1.5s..2.8s before (or right around) the opening greeting.
3. Zero-Setup & Scream-Peak Hard Cut: Trim all teaser clips (0.8s..1.9s each) to start 0.3s..0.5s before impact and hard-cut right at the peak of the scream or crash (cliffhanger cut).

4. Call-and-Response Audio Weaving: Leave breathing windows between VO clauses so funny groans, airbag explosions, and screams answer the narrator's questions (e.g., 'laugh out loud?' at 11.8s immediately followed by the biker's 'Uhhh!' groan at 11.85s).

5. Camera-Hit Finale Jump-Scare: Make the final teaser clip right after 'Let's get started!' (15.22..16.95s) an object flying directly into the camera lens / windshield, using that impact to trigger the Zoom-Blur transition into the WARNING card.
6. Uncluttered Action Center: Keep the center of the frame 100% free of text overlays during teaser impacts so the viewer's eye locks onto the physical action.
7. Dynamic Text-Clause Slicing: Never hardcode segment counts (2..6+ segments); slice VO strictly according to the intro text's natural clauses and the timing of teaser impacts.

V3_and_V1_teaser_montage.total_teaser_clips: 9 to 10 distinct clips (split into 18..20 Part-A / Part-B sub-segments) + 1 nested Warning sequence (0.83s)
V3_and_V1_teaser_montage.clip_selection_rule: Cherry-pick 50% from source/itv.kb*.mp4 and 50% from ITV-Moments-script-*/*.mp4 with the sharpest visual impacts (tire crashes, ladder falls, truck cab flips, tree-cutting kickbacks, bike-into-windshield).
V3_and_V1_teaser_montage.part_A_part_B_razor_rule: Every teaser clip (duration 0.75s..2.54s) is razor-split on V1, V3, and A1 at the exact onset of physical impact: Part A = Setup/Lead-in (0.50s..1.58s, under VO), Part B = Climax/Impact (0.25s..1.04s, +3dB audio boost or VO pause).
V3_and_V1_teaser_montage.speed_ramping_rule: Apply 130%..150% speed (or up to 250%..300% for long approaches) on slow build-up teaser clips so every impact hits within < 1.5s.

V8_kinetic_intro_captions.phrasing_rule: Split the Intro VO into 8..12 ALL-CAPS phrase cards (2..5 words per card, 0.50s..2.46s duration), tightly synced to A2 vocal phrases and V3 teaser cuts, alternating vibrant fill colors (Yellow, Pink/Magenta, Green, Red) with thick black stroke/shadow.

rules: Always pass sequenceName explicitly to avoid editing the wrong sequence when multiple projects/sequences are open.
Use direct HTTP POST to 127.0.0.1:47823/command in batch Python scripts instead of spawning hundreds of subprocesses, reducing 100-clip mutation time from ~4 minutes to <15 seconds.
Never use seq.overwriteClip for subclip placement without setting both V1 and A1 inPoint/outPoint/start/end atomically.

Before placing a V2 shield clip via add-to-timeline, call set-item-in-out with V1's exact inPointSeconds and outPointSeconds; add-to-timeline snapshots existing A1 audio nodeIds so A1 is never touched and A2 remains 100% empty.
